mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in FEDFUNDS signals an easing monetary cycle, reducing discount rates applied to equity cash flows, which compresses discounting and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in UNRATE above 6.0% in the next month signals labor market weakening, eroding consumer confidence and corporate earnings growth, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises above 6.0% in the next month
failure_condition: UNRATE does not rise above 6.0% in the next month, or 5-day forward returns are not negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) in the same quarter indicates robust demand, driving corporate profits and equity valuations higher, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and HOUST increase in the same quarter
failure_condition: Either GDPC1 or HOUST does not increase in the same quarter, or 60-day forward returns are not positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A surge in industrial production (INDPRO) above 95.0 in the next month signals supply-side expansion, reducing bottlenecks and boosting manufacturing activity, which correlates with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO crosses above 95.0 in the next month
failure_condition: INDPRO does not cross above 95.0 in the next month, or 5-day forward returns are not positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged rise in FEDFUNDS during a tightening cycle raises borrowing costs, dampening corporate investment and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS does not increase for 3 consecutive months, or 60-day forward returns are not negative (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Persistent high jobless claims (PAYEMS) indicate labor market stress, reducing consumer confidence and corporate profitability, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS consistently decreases, or 5-day forward returns are not negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in GDP (GDPC1) and retail sales (RSAFS) in the same quarter signals robust demand, driving equity market gains and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and RSAFS increase in the same quarter
failure_condition: Either GDPC1 or RSAFS does not increase in the same quarter, or 20-day forward returns are not positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Sustained high unemployment above 6.0% for 3 months in a labor market stress regime signals prolonged weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 6.0% within 3 months, or 60-day forward returns are not negative (p > 0.05).
